name: Innovex 16" 3-Speed Stand Fan with Timer ISF017
description: 16-inch Innovex stand fan with 3 speed settings, 1-hour timer, 5 blades and height adjustment. Copper motor with 1-year warranty.
details: The Innovex ISF017 is a 16-inch stand fan designed for effective cooling. It features a copper motor, 5 blades, 3 speed settings, 1-hour timer, free neck oscillation, tilting angle and height adjustment. The poly-coated safety grill adds extra protection. Reliable and suitable for homes or offices in Sri Lanka. Backed by a 1-year warranty.
